identity.name: Explorer
identity.one_liner: The Explorer of 1963-1989: matte black dial, 3-6-9 numerals, 36mm, and a 26-year production run.

provenance_events.description: The Explorer 1016 runs from 1963 to 1989 — the longest-running Explorer reference and the one most associated with mountaineering expeditions, polar crossings, and 1970s-era tool-watch culture. The dial proportions and 36mm case became the template for every Rolex Explorer that followed.

narrative.story: The 1016 distilled the Explorer to its lasting form — matte black dial, luminous 3-6-9, calibers 1560 then 1570 — and held it for two and a half decades. Early gilt-dial examples and the rare 'Space-Dweller' variant sit at the top of the market, while later matte watches are the canonical entry into vintage sports Rolex. Its plainness is the point: one dial, one case, no date.
narrative.collector_notes: Gilt dials (pre-circa-1967) trade far above matte. Check for original lume, unpolished lug bevels, and era-correct riveted or folded-link bracelets.
